scope: EAC coastal-jet reference interval between nominal27.5S and30.3S sections only. No extrapolation to full current or downstream extensions.
mean_mask_definition: Region inside−0.05m/s contour of long-term mean alongshore velocity; negative is poleward. Fixed mean-field geometry, not mean instantaneous geometry.
orientation_assumption: Reported source cross-shore areas are treated as normal sections of the editorial reference route for this extrusion scenario. Source grid is rotated20degrees clockwise; exact source section/route orientation correction is not recovered or applied.
shape_assumption: Use source-reported areas directly; no rectangle, ellipse or offshore-distance-times-maximum-depth area inferred. Adjacent areas are connected by linear area interpolation.
temporal_interpretation: Volume of an extruded long-term mean-field mask scenario, not mean of instantaneous threshold-core volumes, a dated observed water volume or an annual seasonal envelope.
